overall: No violation found. The three chairs' meetings and e-mails involved fewer than the four-member quorum of the Subcommittee; the AG advised holding all discussions in noticed, open meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged three school district chairs met repeatedly, including with the superintendent, without posted notice or minutes, deliberating on public business.
allegations.key_passage: Because the meetings and e-mails referenced in the complaint involved three Subcommittee members—less than a quorum—we find that they did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chairs exchanged e-mails, with the superintendent copied, that amounted to unnoticed deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: None of the communications referenced in the complaint included all four Subcommittee members, nor did they include a quorum of any single public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the three chairs formed a 'Chairs Committee' that was a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We need not reach these questions to resolve this complaint.
